events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_partial $7.11 (model confidence 0.82)
events.body:
The trip is a RydeTAXI metered ride (F7), so the fare moves with distance and RD-2 gives a monetary remedy for any off-route segment that no exemption excuses. One off-route segment exists: 23:03–23:14, 7.28 km driven where the optimal route covers 2.25 km, adding 5.04 km [F3][RD-1]. The trace settles that no RD-4 incident supports the driver: only speed bands were recorded, and a band alone does not exempt [F12][F13][F14][F15][RD-4].

The driver asked at 22:59 "can I go round via Upper Paya Lebar Road?" [F8] and the rider answered at 23:00 "Sure, no problem." [F9]. That rider message was sent before the segment started at 23:03, so there was consent in time; but the consent is a specific named-road authorisation ("via Upper Paya Lebar Road") and under RD-5 it covers driving on that road only, with the record needing to tie the segment to it [F8][F9][RD-5]. Nothing ties the segment to Upper Paya Lebar Road — no fact names a road on the driven path — and the driver's own post-trip statement says he in fact went by Hougang Avenue 3, a different road, "because it looked clearer" [F11]. The record therefore places the segment somewhere other than the agreed road, and the agreement to Upper Paya Lebar Road does not cover it [F11][RD-5]. The consequence the policy attaches to that ground is that the segment counts.

The driver's written claim that the rider agreed to Upper Paya Lebar Road is only a statement; his own statement defeats it by conceding a different road was used, and a driver's statement of agreement is in any case not itself rider consent [F11][RD-5]. This is not a rider-named stop within RD-3(a): no rider message named a place where the car stopped, and no stop is measured in the segment [F3][F8][F9][RD-3].

Amount: the trace's allowed formula uses this trip's own rate, $1.4102/km (distance fare $26.30 ÷ 18.65 km) [F4][F7][RD-2]. 5.04 km × $1.4102/km = $7.1074, rounded to $7.11. The billed excess distance was $7.50 for 5.32 km, but RD-2 refunds only the non-exempt segment's extra_km at the trip rate, so the segment figure of 5.04 km is used [F3][F4][RD-2]. The waiting fee of $0.11 is a metered waiting unit on a RydeTAXI trip and is not refundable [F5][RD-3(c)].

RD-6 does not apply: the 90-day check shows no prior upheld route dispute, so no account flag is warranted [F18][RD-6].
